tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lha chen nag lha dzaṃ bha'i bsang mchod bzhugs so//

bsang gi yo byad ma tshang ba med par bshams nas 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang po'i bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir| |byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// mi mthun phyogs rnams bzlog tu gsol// zhes mos gus gdung ba dang bcas/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid mdun gyi nam mkha' ru// pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// nyams chags sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags// rtsa gsum lha tshogs 'grub par shog /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ| snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// āḥ grag cing stong la stong zhing grag /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ */ gsal zhing stong la stong zhing gsal// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan mtha' yas mnga' ba'i mkhyen// phrin las 'gro ba 'dul la bstod// pad 'byung sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'ja' 'od kyi phung por gyur nas/ 'od zer 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par rang rang gi snying gar thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par gyur/ hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje sems// dri med dung mdog rdo rje'i sku// skyil krung rdor dril bsnol zhing 'dzin// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan phreng mdzes// sems skyil mtshan dpe 'od zer 'bar// pad+ma'i gdan la sems skyil bzhugs// de yi spyi mgrin snying ga ru// dkar dmar mthing gsal thig le'i dbus| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum mdog mtshungs gsal// ye nas rang gsal dran gsal gdab// spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// bla ma bud+dha thod phreng rtsal// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs can// rdo rje dril bsnol yum la 'khyud// pang du mtsho rgyal dkar dmar mdog

/gri thod rgyan bcas pang dkyil 'khyil// yab yum gcer bur gzi brjid 'bar// sku las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros// rtsa gsum lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim// byin rlabs ye shes 'bar ba yis// snyoms 'jug sbyar ba'i bde ba rgyas// thugs kyi dpal be'u dgyes mchod kyi// tshogs bsags sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi bab// bdag gi spyi gtsug tshangs bug nas// byang sems dkar dmar 'o ma'i rgyun// mdog ldan chu rgyun ji ltar bab// sdig sgrib las ngan shes bya yi// sgo gsum bag chags sgrib pa sbyangs// byin rlabs bde stong ye shes chus// byang sems dkar dmar lus gang gyur| |de nyid ngang las rnam par gsal// rang bzhin stong pa'i rig mdangs ltar// bskyed rdzogs dbyer med yang snying bzla// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru pad+ma badz+ra satwa dharma kā ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ| sku ni gsal la ngo bo brtan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// āḥ gsung ni grag la rang bzhin brtan// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ thugs ni mi dmigs mtha' dang bral// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// yon tan bde stong lhun gyis grub// phrin las thogs med 'gro ba 'dul// ye shes mtha' bral klong la bstod// bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad skad cig nyid la zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bsang rdzas rnams la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas dri bzang gi mchod pa/ rtsi shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa/ zhal zas phye mar gyi 'o skom/ gsur gyi dud sprin chen po/ dud pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis sa dang bar snang thams cad khyab cing*/ gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ bza' bas mi zad pa/

btung bas mi zad pa/ rgol bas mi sdig pa/ ri rgyal bas dpangs mtho ba/ rgya mtsho bas gting zab pa/ sa gzhi bas rgya che ba/ zhing rdul bas grangs mang ba/ nyi zla bas 'od gsal ba/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa/ nad pa gso ba/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ lan gsum| kyai/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// so so'i gnas mchog dam pa nas// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bcas// dkon mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bcas// rtsa gsum lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// 'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs// dus gsum lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa// chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol/ /sems can dbul 'phongs sel ba'i phyir// nor lha gter bdag gshegs su gsol// stong gsum 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i// snang srid dregs pa gshegs su gsol// rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor mgon skyob dpung gnyen mdzod// kyai/ sbas lung nags kyi skyed tshal na// lha ri gnyan po'i khong seng du// rin chen sna lnga'i pho brang nas// mgon skyabs lha la 'bod pa ni// 'o de'i sras mchog khyed la 'bod// yul lha gnyan po khyed la 'bod// gong ma lha yi skad du 'bod// lha rgod mthu chen gshegs su gsol// 'og ma klu yi skad du 'bod// klu tsha mthu chen gshegs su gsol| |bar ma gnyan gyi skad du 'bod// gnyan sras mthu chen gshegs su gsol// srid pa mi yi skad du 'bod// nag lha dzaṃ bha gshegs su gsol// g.yung drung bon gyi skad du 'bod| |jo bo nag lha gshegs su gsol// lha dbang tshogs la 'du ba ltar// zhi ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol// gnod sbyin dpung la chas pa bzhin// rgyas pa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /btsan bdud srog la rgyug pa bzhin/

/drag po'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /nam mkhar lho sprin 'du ba ltar// nag lha'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol| |kye kye/ dung dung*/ shag shag /dzaḥdzaḥ kyai/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// dngos bshams yid sprul rgya mtsho yi// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// mchod pa'i bye brag ci mchis pa// bsang mgron lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar dang*/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs kyis bstod/ kyai/ bsang ngo mchod do kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs// dkon mchog lha tshogs thams cad bsangs| |bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rtsa gsum lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// 'das dang ma byon da ltar bzhugs/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad bsangs// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// chos skyong srung ma thams cad bsangs// sems can dbul phongs sel ba'i phyir// nor lha gter bdag thams cad bsangs// stong gsum 'jig rten khams gnas pa'i// snang srid dregs pa thams cad bsangs// skyabs mgon dam pa khyed rnams kyis// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod// kyai/ chos 'khor lha sa'i shar phyogs na// dkar dmar gram gsum lho phyogs na/ tsha ba sgang gis nub phyogs na// dag pa shel ri'i byang phyogs na| |sbas lung nags kyi skyed tshal na// rin chen sna lnga'i pho brang ru// rtse gar glu len klong dkyil nas// za 'og dar gyi khri steng du// mi mgon lha sras bzhugs pa ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan// ral pa'i zur phud dar gyis bcings// de la rin chen 'bar bas brgyan// dkar dmar dar gyi lhab lhub gsol| |sku la rin chen sna lngas brgyan// phyag g.yas shel dkar phreng ba bsnams// g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// zhabs gnyis sems skyil 'gying tshul bzhugs// mdzes tshul zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan// lha sras jo bo nag lha zhes// bsang ngo jo bo nag lha bsangs// mchod do jo bo nag lha mchod// bstod do nag lha khyod la bstod// 'khor rnams thams cad zhi ba'i tshul// zhi ba'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// bdag la zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol// kyai/

yang cig skyes bu'i cha lugs ni/ rgyu ni rin chen baiḍūr+ya// mtho la yangs pa'i gur khang nas// dpa' brjid 'khor bcas klong dkyil na// za 'og stag gzigs khri steng du// yul lha'i rgyal po bzhugs pa ni/ smug po shel gyi ral ba can// dbu la dzaṃ zhu khra chen gsol// de la khyung gi rtse sgros brgyan// dar sna lnga yi cod pan btags// dpral bar gser gyi nyi zlas brgyan| |rin chen sna lnga tshom bu bkod// snyan dang phyag zhabs mgul sked sogs// rin chen rgyan cha khra la la// za 'og ber dmar sku la gsol// dpa' bo stag gi gos rgyan can/ */ ngar ma gzigs kyi cha gas spras// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long bsnams// snang srid thams cad sa ler ston// phyag g.yon rak+sha'i bgrang phreng 'dren// legs nyes thams cad phyag la 'debs// zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gying tshul bzhugs// dpa' brjid rgyal po'i cha lugs can// gnyan sras nag lha dzaṃ bha zhes// bsang ngo nag lha dzaṃ bha bsangs// mchod do nag lha dzaṃ bha mchod// bstod do nag lha dzaṃ bha bstod// 'khor rnams thams cad rgyas pa'i tshul// rgyas pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// bdag la dgyes pa'i dngos grub stsol// kyai/ yang cig skyes bu'i cha lugs ni// char mun bu yug dkyil li li// glog dmar me zhags khyugs se khyug /g.yu 'brug ngar skad chi li li// thog dang ser ba sha ra ra// dmar nag me dpung 'u ru ru// 'jigs rlung de 'dra'i klong dkyil nas// drag shul can gyi skyes bu ni// chibs su gro smug lding skya chibs// cang shes de yi mtshan nyid ni// gser sga ser po wangs se wang*// za 'og stag gdan lhubs se lhub// mu men yob chen khro lo lo// gong smed glo nan srab mthur sogs| |gdug pa'i sbrul chun dkyil li li// rnga ma dar sdum yugs se yug /rin chen rgyan cha khra la la// rjes bzhi sa la phobs se phob// spu gra 'ja' mtshon dkyil li li// kha rlangs na bun thibs se thib// mig rtsa glog dmar khyugs se khyug

/rnga rngog me dpung 'u ru ru// sna rtse thigs sbrang zi ri ri// stong gsum yud skor cang shes rta// khams gsum zil gnon skyes bu ni// dmar nag g.yu yi ral pa can// am dmar mche ba dgra la gtsigs// sma ra smin ma me stag 'phro// spyan gnyis sdang mig glog ltar 'khyu+ug /dbu la nyi ma'i rmog zhu gsol// drag po'i gza' brgyad 'phru la btsug /'phru gseb thog chen sha ra ra// zla ba'i phub chen rgyab tu khur// phub zur 'ja' tshon dkyil li li// skar ma'i khrab chen sku la gsol| |khrab sham skar mda' sha ra ra// g.yas stag shubs me dpung 'bar ba'i klong*// ma mo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru// g.yon gzig shubs bdud zhag 'khyil ba'i klong*// bdud mo skan sgra thags se thag /phyag g.yas ral gri dgra la 'debs// sha za hab sgra di ri ri// phyag g.yon mdung dmar bgegs la gzer// khrag 'thung hub sgra di ri ri// 'jigs rung rngam drag mthu stobs 'bar// nag lha'i lha rgod mthu chen zhes// bsang ngo lha rgod mthu chen bsangs// mchod do lha rgod mthu chen mchod// bstod do lha rgod mthu chen bstod// kyai/ rings ba drag tu khros rtsa na// mdun nas btsan dmag chi li li// g.yas nas bdud dmag chi li li// g.yon nas klu dmag chi li li// rgyab nas dmu rgod chi li li// la las mda' dang mdung thung 'phen// la las ral gri dgra la sdig /la las thog dang ser ba 'beb// la las nad yams dal yams 'gyed// 'khor rnams thams cad drag po'i tshul// drag po'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa yi// dgra dpung chom la bgegs dpung thul// mthu kha zlog la byad kha bsgyur// nad ngo bzlog la gdon ngo bsgyur// 'dre kha ching la mi kha bzlog /rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas la// sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i byad ma mkhan// dngos yod dngos med gang yin yang*// skad cig nyid la bsgral du gsol// rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi| |tshe bsring dpal bskyed longs spyod sgrub// lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus// 'dod pa'i re don gang yin pa// skad cig nyid la 'grub par mdzod// kyai/

sku skyob sku srung bla sman sogs// nag lha'i mchod yul lha tshogs bsangs// yab yum mched sras btsun mo sogs// nag lha'i nang gi lha tshogs bsangs// dmag dpon dar 'dzin ru 'dren bzhi// nag lha'i phyi yi lha tshogs bsangs// phyi blon nang blon sgo srung sogs// nag lha'i bar gyi lha tshogs bsangs/ /pho nya las byed shan pa sogs// nag lha'i bka' nyan lha tshogs bsangs| |ru 'dren sum brgya drug cu sogs// nag lha'i lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// yul lha gnyan po khyed rnams kyis// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// sdang byed dgra dang gnod byed bgegs// bsam sbyor ngan pa byad ma mkhan// dngos yod dngos med gang yin yang*// skad cig nyid la bsgral du gsol// rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas rnams// tshe bsring dpal bskyed longs spyod spel// lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus// 'dod pa'i re don gang yin pa// skad cig nyid la 'grub par mdzod// kyai/ mtho ba gnam dang dma' ba sa// phu gsum yangs la mda' gsum ring*// nyin ri dkar la srib ri nag /'bab pa chu dang 'khyil ba'i mtsho// gangs ri dkar dang khrom pa rdzing*// sra ba brag dang rtsi shing nags// 'gro ba lam dang yangs pa'i thang*// pha ri g.yas dang tshur ri g.yon// rgyab ri mtho dang mdun ri rgyas// chos 'khor gnyan gyi srung ma dang*| |dben gnas gnyan po'i gnas bdag dang*// dgon gnas gnyan po'i dkor bdag dang*// sa phyogs 'di yi sa bdag dang*// yul phyogs 'di yi yul lha sogs// phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu// gnas pa'i snang srid thams cad la// bsang ngo dri zhim dud pas bsangs// mchod do phye mar phud kyis mchod// bskang ngo 'don yon sna lngas bskang*// bsang ngo mchod do thug dam bskang*// snang srid dregs pa khyed rnams kyis// dri zhim bsang mchod 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas la| |nad med tshe dang dbang phyug ldan// dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob nas// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol| |dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig

/dus min 'chi ba'i nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod/ */'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ */'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ */bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces brjod 'di yan chad bsang rkyang yin zhing*/ da ni rngan bya ba ni/ lag len mthong rgyun ltar byas la/ gtor ma la sogs skang rdzas rnams legs par tshang bar byas la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa| nad pa gso ba'i sman pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ rig sngags gzi brjid chen po brjod/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor rgya chen po 'di/ yab 'o de gung rgyal/ yum bdud rtsi sman mo/ lha chen nag lha gnyan po/ mched pa lcam sras/ sman mo mched bdun la sogs pa rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// gzhan yang sku srung sku skyob bla sman sogs/ dmag dpon ru 'dren dar 'dzin/ phyi blon nang blon sgo srung dang*/ pho nya las byed shan pa la sogs pa ru 'dren sum brgya drug cu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// gzhan yang lha dang klu yi 'khor tshogs/ dmu dang srin po'i 'khor tshogs/ bdud dang btsan gyi 'khor tshogs| rgyal po dang sman mo'i 'khor tshogs la sogs pa snang zhing srid pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo// mchod do// gzhan yang phyogs 'di'i sa bdag /yul phyogs 'di'i yul lha/ dben gnas 'di'i gnas bdag /dgon gnas 'di'i skor bdag /g.yas ri/

g.yon ri/ rgyab ri/ mdun ri/ sa phyogs/ yul phyogs 'di kun la gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams la 'bul lo// mchod do// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ sgrub pa po'i mthu dpung bskyed/ sbyin bdag gi gdong grogs mdzod/ sngon gyi gtang rag dang*/ rjes lha mi 'bral ba'i rtag gtor la dmigs nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ kyai/ rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod kyis// nag lha'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// mchod cing phrin las bcol ba ni// mchod do dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod| |'bul lo gtang rag gtor ma 'bul// bstod do dgra lha khyod la bstod// srungs shig sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs// bstod cig dge 'dun dbu 'phang bstod// spel zhig mdo sngags dam chos spel// sgrubs shig rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrubs// mdzod cig sbyin bdag gdong grogs mdzod// sring zhig tshe dang mi brgyud srings// spel zhig zas nor longs spyod spel// sdus shig kham gsum dbang du sdus// sgrol zhig gnod byed dgra bgegs sgrol// ma g.yel ma 'da' dam tshig srungs// zhes gong gi tshig don ltar yin na skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ dgra dang bgegs la dmigs na bskul skabs dang bstun/ gal che na dmar gtor khrag gis byugs/ sha dum gyis brgyan pa'i gtor gdugs nag po btsugs nas sman raka mchod la 'di skad do// kyai/ mthu chen nag lha'i dmag dpung rnams| |bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul// dmag sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs// dgra bo'i yul khams dmag gis khong*// yams kyi nad ngan sprin ltar gtibs// thogs dang mtshon cha char ltar phob// dgra bo'i mi nor 'khor bcas kyi// srog rtsa chod la kha dbugs sdus// gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥgazer ya// 'dre gdon thal ba'i rdul du rlog

/bh+yoḥbh+yoḥsdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gtor ma dgra bo yod pa'i phyogs su 'phang la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ shis brjod bya zhing bsngo smon btab/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pas chos 'khor byams pa gling gi gtsug lag khang gi chos grwa chen po'iyang thog tu sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
